result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. The main visual issue is that the horizontal 'Fastest near you' carousel clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with its title truncated, which looks slightly broken though it may be intentional scroll affordance. Otherwise layout, contrast, and hierarchy are solid.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third card (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right screen edge and its restaurant name is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, giving a slightly broken/clipped appearance.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a fade/peek affordance to signal scrollability, and apply text truncation with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccol…') so the clipped title looks intentional.

issues.description: The promo banner text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is small and low-contrast white-on-green, making the terms harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Slightly increase font size or weight of the terms line to improve legibility while keeping the green background.
